title: HYDRA: Proactive Android Malware Drift Adaptation via Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.26352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concept drift, driven by the rapid evolution of Android malware, severely degrades the performance of machine learning detectors. Current adaptation strategies are often reactive, responding only after performance has dropped and imposing a significant manual annotation burden, or they are proactive but rely on unstable adversarial training and incomplete, single-level graph representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose HYDRA (Hybrid Drift Adaptation), a proactive adaptation framework that learns drift-invariant representations from hierarchically structured data. HYDRA first models applications using a hybrid graph structure, combining fine-grained Control Flow Graphs (CFGs) and coarse-grained Function Call Graphs (FCGs) to capture comprehensive behavioral patterns. It then introduces a novel cross-domain contrastive learning objective that aligns historical (source) and new (target) data distributions. By generating pseu

translated_title: HYDRA：基于层次图对比学习的主动式安卓恶意软件漂移适应
translated_abstract: 由安卓恶意软件快速演化所驱动的概念漂移，严重降低了机器学习检测器的性能。当前的适应策略通常是被动式的，只有在性能下降后才做出响应，并带来沉重的人工标注负担；或者是主动式的，但依赖于不稳定的对抗性训练和不完整的单层图表示。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了HYDRA（混合漂移适应），这是一个主动式适应框架，能够从层次化结构的数据中学习漂移不变的表示。HYDRA首先使用混合图结构对应用程序进行建模，结合细粒度的控制流图（CFG）和粗粒度的函数调用图（FCG），以捕获全面的行为模式。然后，它引入了一种新颖的跨域对比学习目标，用于对齐历史（源）数据分布和新（目标）数据分布。通过生成伪……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: HYDRA提出了一种主动式安卓恶意软件漂移适应框架，通过融合控制流图与函数调用图的层次混合图结构和跨域对比学习，学习漂移不变的表示，从而有效应对恶意软件演化带来的概念漂移问题。
en_tdlr: HYDRA is a proactive Android malware drift adaptation framework that learns drift-invariant representations through hierarchical hybrid graph structures (combining CFGs and FCGs) and cross-domain contrastive learning to effectively combat concept drift caused by malware evolution.
